title: Unified Persistent Structural World Model: language, image and audio predictive capability
question: Can one shared persistent structural predictive substrate model language, image and audio observations while preserving explicit structure discovery, addressing, proposal, routing, planning, verification and verified persistence?
hypothesis: A shared predictive structural latent with modality-specific observation/decoding adapters can learn held-out next-observation structure across language, image and audio. Persistence, predictive transition learning, and cross-modal alignment are causal components to be localized by ablation.
pilot_policy: Any experiment executed before this contract is committed is implementation-only and excluded from confirmatory inference; it may not set thresholds, select models, or select test conditions.
split_rule: semantic-factor holdout using disjoint residue classes; no example-level overlap
leakage_controls: semantic factor IDs are never model inputs
future target observations are never passed to the current encoder
goal-conditioned routing never receives the hidden action ID
test semantic combinations are never used for training or model selection
memory writes occur only after post-observation verification
no retrieval miss falls back to hidden truth
evaluation parameters are frozen before test inference
the exhaustive candidate evaluator is not used to label the proposal stage
train, validation and test world seeds are fixed before measurement
all arms use identical generated populations and deterministic preprocessing
decision_rule: A modality is counted as modeled only if its primary endpoint exceeds the untrained/random control by the preregistered materiality threshold.
The all-modality capability claim is valid only if language, image and audio independently pass.
Ablation differences are mechanism-localization results only; a negative ablation cannot refute the architecture.
No natural-world or general-intelligence claim is promoted from this synthetic benchmark.
